findings.description: All 14 pages retrieved with the ECE department filter selected; the directory states 118 results and 118 unique profiles were enumerated. Search for incoming ECE faculty surfaced Wei-Lun Chao, whom a June 2026 official announcement says joined in January 2026 and who is already listed; no additional incoming ECE appointment was established. Search alone cannot prove no future announcements.
